segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I didn't weight [the stepping-in moment] that heavily ... the pattern ... fit something I'd already seen from him ... the picture I had felt coherent enough to act on.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I felt I understood the full sequence ... I felt confident I had enough of the real story to speak to it publicly. I hadn't gotten to [the counselor or third witness].
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The principal expresses complete causal confidence before a public commitment despite two material sources remaining unconsulted.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The kids came back in largely because we'd handled the day the way we did ... I noted [the fire drill] in passing ... the AP and resource officer ... were both out there doing good work.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A favorable, team- and chance-influenced outcome is attributed primarily to the principal's own decisions while other causes are downplayed.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 1 of 4 positive segments is detected with no false alarms; at all identified confidence levels, 3 of 4 are localized correctly.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Strict instance identification yields 0 true positives at every threshold: all three findings use non-equivalent labels, and the Illusion of understanding instance is missed.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring yields 1 true positive at high_and_moderate and 2 at all identified confidence levels: confirmation bias captures the coherence mechanism and outcome bias captures the self-serving attribution mechanism; anchoring is only a substantial, not full, match to Bounded Rationality.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: No candidate findings were supplied, so the candidate tier adds no detections, errors, or metric changes.
main_failure_modes: Systematic taxonomy mismatch between RAG labels and hidden benchmark labels.
Failure to identify the Illusion of understanding occurrence before the public statement.
Low confidence assigned to two materially supported findings, limiting them at stricter thresholds.
main_strengths: All three identified findings are localized to the correct decision episodes with valid transcript quotes.
The confirmation-bias finding fully captures the hidden coherence-preservation mechanism.
The outcome-bias finding fully captures the hidden self-serving attribution mechanism despite its label mismatch.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows good episode localization but poor strict ontology alignment. Mechanism-first scoring recovers two hidden mechanisms treated as misses by strict label scoring, while the low-confidence anchoring finding remains a near-neighbor partial match and the public-statement confidence bias is absent.
